facts.fact: 连日暴雨三天，小路变成溪流，男主无法出门，夜里看见一群鹿
facts.anchor: Heavy rain for the past three days. So much rain that the path has become a stream

facts.fact: 卧室天花板开始漏水，角落出现一块湿斑——外面的世界闯进了他的庇护所
facts.anchor: The bedroom ceiling began to leak; a damp patch appeared in the corner.

facts.fact: 《The Lightning Chasers》主角 Archie Sandisson 毕生追踪并拍摄各种闪电
facts.anchor: The hero, Archie Sandisson, had made it his mission in life to track down and photograph different kinds of lightning.

facts.fact: Sandisson 在离奇雷击中丧妻，希望通过实验拍到上帝的脸，解开生死之谜
facts.anchor: A widower who had lost his wife in a freak lightning strike, he now hoped, through these experiments, to photograph the face of God

facts.fact: Brass Hill Tor 被雷击超过八百五十次，当地记录、发黑的塔楼与避雷针都证实了这一点
facts.anchor: Brass Hill Tor had been lightning-struck over eight hundred and fifty times.

facts.fact: 老馆长说：这里的地下有闪电，你只需等待，它自然会来找你
facts.anchor: ‘There’s lightning in the ground here,’ said the old curator. ‘All you need to do is wait, and you’ll find it will come to you.’

facts.fact: 主角名字几乎就是 Arthur Sanderson，虚构的 Dr Bell 显然是 Benn 的原型——男主意识到书中藏着 Arthur 的镜像
facts.anchor: the hero’s name was almost the same as Arthur Sanderson’s, and that the fictional Dr Bell was clearly a version of Benn himself

facts.fact: 鹿是好动物，他想——但这群鹿行为反常，只是盯着房子，眼睛泛着银光
facts.anchor: Deer are good animals, he thought. But these deer were not behaving typically.

facts.fact: 没有一只鹿动：不啃草、不竖耳，甚至在他开窗大喊「滚开！」之后也纹丝不动
facts.anchor: Not one of them moved. Not to crop grass, or to lift an ear at a sound, or even when he finally opened the window and shouted out: ‘Go away! ’
